spec.description: FHIR traffic for this HAPI FHIR server by resource type, interaction, and operation. Metrics come from the fhir.server.requests counter the server records; unhandled paths come from traces.

spec.title: Requests per minute by interaction
spec.description: Requests per minute grouped by FHIR interaction, averaged over the last 5 minutes.

spec.expr:
sum by (fhir_interaction) (
last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""}[5m])
 - (fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""} offset 5m or last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""}[5m]) * 0)) / 5

spec.title: Error share by interaction
spec.description: Share of requests in the last 5 minutes that ended in a 4xx or 5xx response, per interaction.

spec.expr:
sum by (fhir_interaction) (
last_over_time(fhir_server_errors_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""}[5m])
 - (fhir_server_errors_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""} offset 5m or last_over_time(fhir_server_errors_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""}[5m]) * 0))
 / sum by (fhir_interaction) (
last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""}[5m])
 - (fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""} offset 5m or last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""}[5m]) * 0))

spec.title: Minutes since last metric sample
spec.description: Telemetry liveness. The agent exports every 60 s, so a value above 3 means the pipeline is down or the server is.

spec.title: Resource interactions
spec.description: Requests per FHIR resource type in the selected time range. Types outside telemetry.resource-types count as other.

spec.expr:
sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (fhir_resource_type) (
last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_resource_type!=""}[$__range])
 - (fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_resource_type!=""} offset $__range or last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_resource_type!=""}[$__range]) * 0)) > 0))

spec.title: Operations
spec.description: Requests per registered operation in the selected time range. Names no provider declares count as other.

spec.expr:
sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (fhir_operation) (
last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_operation!=""}[$__range])
 - (fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_operation!=""} offset $__range or last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_operation!=""}[$__range]) * 0)) > 0))

spec.title: Average requests per minute, selected range
spec.description: All interactions combined: requests in the selected time range divided by its length in minutes.

spec.expr:
sum(
last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""}[$__range])
 - (fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""} offset $__range or last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""}[$__range]) * 0)) / ($__range_s / 60) or vector(0)

spec.title: Top requests (requests in range)
spec.description: Request count per resource type, interaction, and operation over the selected time range, highest first.

spec.expr:
sum by (fhir_resource_type, fhir_interaction, fhir_operation) (
last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""}[$__range])
 - (fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""} offset $__range or last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""}[$__range]) * 0)) > 0

spec.title: Average processing time by route (traces)
spec.description: Mean duration of the server spans for each http.route, from Tempo, so no metric series are stored for it. Routes name the request shape, not the resource type.

spec.title: Unhandled request paths (traces)
spec.description: Paths of requests that HAPI bound to no handler, from the url.path of server spans tagged /fhir/unhandled, in the selected time range. Paths carry client text and ids.

spec.title: CPU usage
spec.description: The share of the CPU capacity of the machine that the JVM process used in the latest measurement interval, from jvm.cpu.recent_utilization.

spec.title: Memory usage
spec.description: Bytes the JVM uses for heap and non-heap memory, summed over the memory pools, from jvm.memory.used. The dashed line is the heap in use as a share of the heap limit the JVM reports (jvm.memory.limit), on the right axis, with threshold lines at 80% and 90%. The JVM sizes the limit from the container memory limit, 25% of it unless -XX:MaxRAMPercentage says otherwise.

spec.title: Resource interactions, selected range
spec.description: Requests in the selected range with a FHIR interaction other than an operation: read, vread, search, create, update, patch, delete, history, validate, meta, graphql, capabilities, batch, and transaction. Requests that HAPI bound to no handler are left out.

spec.expr:
sum(
last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_interaction!~"operation|unhandled|other"}[$__range])
 - (fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_interaction!~"operation|unhandled|other"} offset $__range or last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_interaction!~"operation|unhandled|other"}[$__range]) * 0)) or vector(0)

spec.title: Operation invocations, selected range
spec.description: Requests in the selected range that invoked a FHIR operation, such as $everything or $validate, at server, type, or instance level.

spec.expr:
sum(
last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_operation!=""}[$__range])
 - (fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_operation!=""} offset $__range or last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_operation!=""}[$__range]) * 0)) or vector(0)

spec.title: Last server start
spec.description: Start time of the newest JVM that exports the fhir_server_start_time_seconds gauge for the selected service.

spec.title: Server starts, selected range
spec.description: JVMs of the selected service whose start time falls inside the selected range. A server that was already running when the range begins adds nothing, so for a single server this is its restart count unless its first start is inside the range.

spec.title: Access decisions per minute
spec.description: Authorization decisions per minute, stacked by decision type.

spec.title: Rejections by reason
spec.description: Rejected requests per minute grouped by the rejection reason.

spec.title: Identity provider errors (range)
spec.description: Access decisions that failed because the identity provider could not be reached or validated.

spec.title: Rejected (range)
spec.description: Requests rejected by the auth interceptor in the selected time range.

spec.title: Bypass header share
spec.description: Share of access decisions that used the public access bypass header.

spec.title: Access decisions
spec.description: Log lines for each access decision, including method, reason, client id and path.

spec.title: Match requests per minute by operation and validation
spec.description: Match requests per minute grouped by operation and validation level.

spec.title: Match outcomes
spec.description: Match requests per minute stacked by outcome.

spec.title: Matches per request (range)
spec.description: How many matches each completed request returned, one slice per count.

spec.title: FAST Identity Matching
